questions.questionText: 22) Which of the following is the converse of: "If wages increase, then inflation decreases."?
options: If inflation increases, then wages decrease.
If inflation increases, then wages increase.
If inflation decreases, then wages increase.
If inflation decreases, then wages decrease.
questions.explanation: A conditional statement has the form "If $p$, then $q$", where $p$ is the hypothesis and $q$ is the conclusion. The **converse** of a statement is formed by switching the hypothesis and the conclusion, resulting in the form "If $q$, then $p$".\n- **Original Statement ($p \to q$):** $p$ (wages increase), $q$ (inflation decreases).\n- **Converse ($q \to p$):** If inflation decreases, then wages increase. (Option C is correct.)
